tasks.title: Promote the staged task-details and task_comments migrations into the live tree
tasks.dod: both paired migrations apply cleanly on top of 000012 and revert cleanly in reverse order; existing task rows get description '' and priority 'medium'; the priority CHECK rejects a value outside low/medium/high

tasks.title: Extend the task domain with description, priority, due date and the Comment entity
tasks.dod: unit tests: description over 4000 runes rejected and exactly 4000 accepted (TSK-02); priority outside low/medium/high rejected, empty means medium (TSK-03/TSK-04); a nil due date is legal and clearable (TSK-05/TSK-07); comment author/body empty or over 200/2000 runes rejected (TSK-09); no framework imports

tasks.title: Persist task details and comments; carry the card fields in board state
tasks.dod: integration tests: a task round-trips description/priority/due_date; board state carries has_description + comment_count and NO description body; comments insert/list (oldest first)/delete; deleting a task removes its comments (TSK-11); a task lookup returns its board id so callers can scope by board

tasks.title: Task use-cases accept details; state reads serve task detail (editor + token-scoped)
tasks.dod: unit tests (repo faked through the port): create/edit carry the new fields and still broadcast exactly once to the task's board (TSK-14); GetTaskDetail returns task + comments; GetPublicTaskDetail refuses a task whose board differs from the token's board with the same error as an unknown token (TSK-13)

tasks.title: Implement the comment use-cases (add, delete) with board-scoped broadcast
tasks.dod: unit tests: a valid comment is persisted and broadcasts board.state_changed to exactly the task's board; an invalid author/body is rejected before any repository write (TSK-09); delete broadcasts the same way (TSK-10)

tasks.title: Extend the task HTTP surface: detail GET and the new fields on create/edit
tasks.dod: integration tests: GET /api/v1/tasks/{taskId} returns TaskDetail; create/edit accept description/priority/due_date and echo them; a malformed due_date returns 400 validation.invalid_due_date; an over-long description returns 422 task.description_too_long; an unknown priority returns 422 task.priority_invalid

tasks.title: Add the comment routes (list, add, delete)
tasks.dod: integration tests: POST returns 201 with the created comment, GET returns them oldest first, DELETE returns 204 and the comment is gone; an unknown task returns 404 task.not_found (never a raw FK 500); an unknown comment returns 404 comment.not_found

tasks.title: Serve public task details in the 300/min tier and wire the new handlers
tasks.dod: integration tests through the real server.New: GET /api/v1/public/{token}/tasks/{taskId} returns the detail with no board_id/public_link leak, a task of another board returns 404 board.link_invalid (TSK-13), the route sits in the 300/min tier (the 61st request still passes, the 301st does not), and no mutating comment route exists under the public token

tasks.title: Extend the web API layer with the task detail and comment endpoints
tasks.dod: types mirror the contract (TaskCard on the board, Task with description in detail responses); boardApi gains getTask/getPublicTask/addComment/deleteComment and passes the new fields on create/edit; unit tests pin the request shapes; typecheck clean

tasks.title: Show the card markers: priority, due date, description, comment count
tasks.dod: component tests: the priority marker reflects the task's priority; a due date renders as a badge and a past one renders with the destructive token (TSK-06); the description icon only appears when has_description; the comment count only appears when comment_count > 0; markers render in the drag ghost too; tokens only, no hardcoded colours

tasks.title: Build the task details modal (editor) and its read-only viewer twin
tasks.dod: component tests: the editor modal loads the detail, edits title/description/priority/due date/assignee and saves; the comment form pre-fills the logged-in name, posts and shows the new comment, blocks an empty one, deletes a comment; the viewer modal renders the same content with no input, no comment form and no delete; delete-the-task stays where it was

tasks.title: End-to-end flow through the real UI plus the changelog entry
tasks.dod: one Playwright spec drives create task → open details → description + priority + due date + comment → markers visible on the card → the same details read-only through a public link; CHANGELOG.md gains a partner-facing section in the existing style
